name: Ravin Vasudev
headline: Principal Cloud and Platform Architect
summary: Cloud and Platform Architecture leader with 19+ years of experience delivering enterprise cloud transformation, platform engineering, and distributed systems modernization across multiple industries.
Combines deep software engineering foundations with hands-on cloud architecture, platform engineering, and DevSecOps leadership to design resilient, secure, and cost-efficient systems at scale.
Proven track record in Cloud Center of Excellence leadership, enterprise cloud governance, landing zone strategy, and multi-team technical execution.
careerHighlights: Cloud Architect in a Cloud Center of Excellence, driving enterprise cloud governance and adoption strategy.
Led architecture strategy for Depot360, a multi-region cloud-native EV fleet electrification platform on AWS and Kubernetes.
Directed architecture alignment across 4 cross-functional teams with 15+ engineers.
Reduced deployment cycle times by 40% through GitOps and DevSecOps automation.
Improved CI/CD and build execution efficiency by 60% through modernization initiatives.
Designed telecommunications platform capabilities serving 200+ million subscribers across 38 countries.
Built high-throughput messaging services supporting 100K+ daily SMS and email transactions.
Recipient of multiple Siemens STAR Awards and two Etisalat Hero Awards.
